text:
Mika Sorensen: Hey team — just unboxed my welcome kit. Monitor's fine but the USB-C hub is missing and the USB-A dongle is broken (port bent). Also I can't authenticate to redwood-sec; it says 'EAP: No matching TLS cert found'. Any quick help?
Harper (People Ops): welcome Mika!! sorry about that. pinging IT and shipping here. Also if you want the SF pickup option let me know.
Jules_IT: Hi Mika — Jules from IT. Can you DM the order number and post the hub model/serial? For the Wi-Fi error, are you using machine cert auth or PEAP? The 'No matching TLS cert' usually means the device certificate wasn't provisioned.
Mika Sorensen: Order: 1Z555ZZ99900011122. Hub model: RWD-HUB-4P-001 serial HUB-2C4D6. I'm on a company MacBook Pro, trying to use machine cert as per onboarding docs.
it-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026-0588 (assigned to it_support).
Jules_IT: Thanks. I've kicked the machine cert enrollment job for your device and sent a push to the MDM. Try `profiles status -type certificate` in terminal and paste output if it still fails.
Mika Sorensen: Ran the command, output: "No profiles found".
Jules_IT: Ok that explains it. Did you enroll in the MDM during first-boot? If not, go to https://mdm.redwood.dev/enroll and use the enrollment token sent to your email. If the token expired, DM me and I'll reissue.
Harper (People Ops): Shipping side — the hub was marked missing in the manifest, we're sending a replacement plus a USB-A adapter and a clamp mount for the monitor. ETA 48 hours.
Mika Sorensen: Tried the MDM enroll link and it succeeded! `profiles status -type certificate` now shows the cert CN=redwood-mgmt. Attempting Wi-Fi join...Connected! :tada:
Jules_IT: Great. For the bent USB-A port on the dongle, keep it aside and we'll include a spare dongle and a powered USB-C hub in the replacement box. Leaving the hardware follow-up open on INC-2026-0588.
Mika Sorensen: Thank you both. One small request: can the replacement hub include a short USB-C to USB-C cable (the one in the box was 2m and too stiff)? Prefer something 30-40cm.
Harper (People Ops): Noted — will add a short 40cm cable to the shipment.
it-bot: Shipping label created: RWD-REPL-46981. Tracking: 1Z555ZZ99900011123.
Mika Sorensen: Awesome. Wi-Fi and cert are working now. Will wait for the replacement hub. Thanks y'all! :relieved:
